extension.description:
Immediate extension EntityType node.  Since we only support a strict type hierarchy
at the instance level, there is at most one extension type for a node.

title:
A node in the type hierarchy for an instance of an extended type. Used as the return type for
{@link Persistable#typeOf} and the {@link Meta#typeHierarchy} field.

WARNING - EntityType must never be used in any persistable field as it is inherently
          recursive and that is not well supported.
name: EntityType
